#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o app .

package lru

import (
	"bytes"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRun(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct{ in, want string }{
		{"2
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
SET c 3
GET b
SIZE
", "1
NULL
2
"},
		{"2
SET a 1
SET b 2
SET a 9
SET c 3
GET a
GET b
GET c", "9
NULL
3
"},
		{"3
SET x 1
DEL x
DEL x
SIZE
GET x
", "1
0
0
NULL
"},
		{"1
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
GET b
SIZE
", "NULL
2
1
"},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		var out bytes.Buffer
		if err := Run(strings.NewReader(tt.in), &out); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if out.String() != tt.want {
			t.Errorf("Run(%q) = %q, want %q", tt.in, out.String(), tt.want)
		}
	}
}
